description: The pie chart represents the relative share of the most frequent languages in a dataset. There are a total of 10 slices, each representing a different language. The largest slice represents English, which accounts for 42.8% of the dataset. The second largest slice represents Spanish, which accounts for 31.4% of the dataset. The remaining slices represent Russian (5.7%), Other (5.8%), French (2.9%), German (3.6%), Chinese (2.5%), Thai (1.9%), Portuguese (Brazil) (1.8%), and Catalan (1.7%). The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
